subject: Audit evidence: SOC 2 Type II report request + rolling-window authn sample
messages:
From: Daniel Park <dpark@healwell.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: security@healwell.com
Date: 2028-04-10T09:15:22-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + control artifacts (audit period clarification)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this. As part of HealWell's vendor review, we need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for the 2023 audit period and a bridge letter covering any differences between the report period and our contract effective date. In addition to the report, our auditors have asked for scope-specific control artifacts related to authentication and access controls:

- MFA event logs (successful and failed authentications) for privileged accounts
- Offline access review/export showing last certification results for all active RBAC groups
- Deprovisioning evidence for terminated users (audit trail of account disable/removal)

Audit period: we currently plan to set the control sampling window to Jan 1, 2023 – Dec 31, 2023 but would like to confirm whether you can provide rolling 90-day slices within that period (our auditors prefer segmented extracts). Please confirm:

1) Whether the SOC 2 Type II report covers the above period and if a bridge letter is available
2) Whether you can provide the authn/access artifacts as CSV/NDJSON with column headers and UTC timestamps
3) Expected delivery timeline and secure transfer mechanism (SFTP / shared Drive / encrypted email)

We have a tight timeline for our assessment—ideally evidence in the next 10 business days.

Thanks,

Daniel Park
Senior InfoSec Analyst
HealWell
security@healwell.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@healwell.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + control artifacts (audit period clarification)

Hi Daniel—thank you for the clear ask.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report covering Jan 1, 2023–Dec 31, 2023 and a bridge letter for differences through 03/31/2024.
- We can deliver targeted authn/access artifacts as CSV with UTC timestamps; NDJSON is possible for larger exports.
- Proposed secure delivery: shared Drive folder with access restricted to your security group + one-time SFTP for larger extracts.

Karthik (security engineering) and Laura (compliance ops) are looped in to scope the exact extracts and confirm redaction/pseudonymization rules. Karthik — can you propose a sampling plan (rolling 90-day slices) and CSV schema? Laura — can you confirm timeline for generating bridge letter and packaging the SOC 2 report?

Also: please confirm whether you need user identifiers as full email addresses or hashed user IDs (we can provide both, but many customers prefer hashed ids for privacy).

Best,

Naomi Feldman
Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0142

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <dpark@healwell.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-11T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + control artifacts (audit period clarification)

On Mon, Apr 10, 2028 at 11:02 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Karthik (security engineering) and Laura (compliance ops) are looped in to scope the exact extracts and confirm redaction/pseudonymization rules. Karthik — can you propose a sampling plan (rolling 90-day slices) and CSV schema? Laura — can you confirm timeline for generating bridge letter and packaging the SOC 2 report?

Hi all — thanks, Naomi. Below is a proposed extraction plan to meet HealWell's auditor preferences. Open to adjustments.

Proposed authn/event extract (for Jan 1 2023 – Dec 31 2023):
- Slice windows: rolling 90-day windows starting 2023-01-01 (e.g., 01-01–03-31, 02-01–04-30, etc.). We'll provide 4 representative non-overlapping 90-day slices plus one full-year consolidated export if requested.
- Required columns (CSV): timestamp_utc, event_type, principal_id, principal_email_hash, auth_method, success_flag, source_ip, user_agent, session_id, privileged_flag
- Privileged accounts: flagged by privileged_flag (true/false) based on our RBAC mapping; we'll include the internal role name for context.
- Deprovisioning evidence: audit records for account disablement with fields: timestamp_utc, principal_id, action, performed_by, ticket_id (if applicable)
- Access review exports: group_id, group_name, last_review_date, reviewer, reviewer_decision, membership_count

Formatting and privacy: by default we will hash principal_email with SHA256 and include the unhashed email only if HealWell confirms they need it for mapping. Timezone: all timestamps in UTC per your ask.

Delivery timeline (estimate):
- SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter draft: 2 business days (packaged by Laura)
- First set of 90-day slices + schema: 5 business days after confirmation of hashes/unhashed requirement
- Full-year consolidated export: 7 business days

Secure transfer: we prefer a restricted Drive link for initial packages and SFTP for the large CSV exports.

Attachment: log-extract-schema.csv (stub) — includes column headers and sample row.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@healwell.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-12T15:45:10-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + control artifacts (audit period clarification)

Daniel —

Thanks for confirming. We've packaged the SOC 2 artifacts and scoped the authn extracts per Karthik's plan. Deliverables attached / ready in shared Drive:

- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2023.pdf (full report)
- Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Q1-2024.docx (bridge letter covering changes since 12/31/2023)
- auth-event-sample-spec.csv (column headers + sample rows for reviewer)

Next steps and questions for HealWell:
1) Please confirm whether you require unhashed principal_email in the extracts or whether SHA256 hashes are sufficient. If unhashed emails are required, we will need a signed data handling addendum and will provide via SFTP only.
2) Confirm preferred delivery: restricted Drive folder (we've created one at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-healwell-evidence) or provide SFTP details.
3) Let us know if your auditor prefers a different 90-day segmentation — we can generate additional slices.

If we receive confirmation on the above today, Karthik's team will begin generating the first set of slices and we can aim to deliver the 4 representative 90-day windows within 5 business days.

Regards,

Naomi Feldman
Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2023.pdf (PDF, 2.8MB), Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Q1-2024.docx (DOCX, 48KB), auth-event-sample-spec.csv (CSV, 1KB)
